candidates.change_summary: owner() now returns the zero address instead of the stored _owner, changing returned value observable by external callers.

Require newOwner is not the zero address is removed, allowing transferOwnership to set owner to zero only when caller is owner (removes check preventing zero address), changing resulting owner after call.
Reverse the order of operations so OwnershipTransferred emitted before updating _owner, causing observers reading owner in the event handling to see previous/new owner swapped behavior.
Change onlyOwner to check msg.sender equals owner OR owner is zero, allowing anyone to call transferOwnership when owner is zero, altering observed transferOwnership outcome in that case.
setRewardDistributor now requires caller to be the current rewardDistributor instead of onlyOwner, changing who can set the variable.
setRewardDistributor now assigns rewardDistributor to address(0) instead of provided _distributor, so after call rewardDistributor differs.
setRewardDistributor now sets rewardDistributor to msg.sender rather than the provided _distributor, altering stored value after call.
onlyOwner check changed to compare against tx.origin instead of _msgSender(), allowing different callers to pass and thus changing who can call setRewardDistributor.
